owner asked me to match the symptoms, and offered Allium cepa / Allium sativum. Matched: its own sentences ('Like scrapings of meat; Copious (watery); Copious of coagulated blood; Constipation alternating with diarrhoea') sit at lines 1178-1179 of the second scan, directly under section 8 'AMMONIUM MURIATICUM'. The book has NO Allium section at all (0 occurrences), so Allium is ruled out - and the slot confirms it: after Aloe comes Alumina, then Ammonium muriaticum.

second_scan_confirmations.what: Readings settled by finding each entry's own symptom sentences in a SECOND SCAN of the same book (Internet Archive item in.ernet.dli.2015.94901, Bell, Homoeopathic Therapeutics, 7th ed. 1906). The remedy heading above the matched sentences is the entry's remedy; the line number is the evidence.
